headline: IDF Neutralizes Hamas Cell Leader in Gaza Amid Expanded Security Zones
subheadline: Israel’s Defense Minister Katz vowed no withdrawal from Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza, as the UAE released $212 million in frozen Iranian assets, including 1.5 tons of gold.
lede: The IDF struck a Hamas cell leader in northern Gaza, killing one and injuring another, while Israel’s Defense Minister Katz affirmed the military’s permanent presence in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza. Simultaneously, Houthi rebels launched two ballistic missiles at the port of Mocha, and the UAE transferred 1.5 tons of gold worth $212 million to Tehran as part of released Iranian assets. In Ukraine, Russian forces amassed over 6,200 Geran drones, with potential for 600-1,000 drones per attack, and a Wildberries warehouse fire in Brovary highlighted infrastructure vulnerability. Ukrainian air defenses are reported as overwhelmed, limiting public data on Russian missile launches, while Russian troops allegedly seized Vodianoye in Kharkiv.

sections.title: Drone Surge Threatens Ukrainian Supply Lines
sections.body: Ukrainian forces reported a fire at a Wildberries warehouse in Brovary, indicating continued attacks on Russian logistics infrastructure. Russian sources claim the stockpile of over 6,200 Geran drones enables potential deployment of 600-1,000 drones in a single strike. Deputy Skorokhod noted that Ukrainian air defense systems are in a catastrophic state, limiting transparency on Russian missile launches.

sections.title: Houthi Missile Strike Targets Mocha Port
sections.body: The IDF conducted an airstrike in northern Gaza’s Beit Lahiya, killing one and injuring another, targeting a Hamas cell leader linked to planned attacks. Israel’s Defense Minister Katz declared the military will not withdraw from Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza, signaling a prolonged presence. Houthi rebels launched two ballistic missiles at the port of Mocha, escalating maritime hostilities.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous expansion of Israeli security zones and Houthi missile attacks signal a coordinated escalation across maritime and land fronts. Russia’s drone buildup and Ukraine’s overwhelmed air defenses reflect a shift toward high-volume, low-precision strikes targeting critical infrastructure.
